srs_deltas.detail: The proxy keeps 0xE9 as U+00E9 and the in-memory adapter test is green, but over a real TinyHttpd 3.1.1 socket the client receives 0xC3 0xA9 because TinyHttpd writes header chars as UTF-8. TinyHttpd and NaruServe-tinyhttpd were not changed; AC-9 should name the adapter it holds for (or wait for a TinyHttpd fix). The scratch socket test was not committed.

srs_deltas.detail: The 64 KiB bound counts the status line and header lines with their CRLFs, not the closing blank line; interim 1xx heads count toward the same bound as the final head, so endless interim heads cannot keep the proxy reading. 65536 bytes pass, 65537 fail (tested).

Left for wave 18 (FR-PROXY-015/017): a read timeout while reading the head still passes through as the existing HttpException 502 (not READ_TIMEOUT), and any other socket error during the head read, including a future total-timeout watchdog close, maps to INVALID_RESPONSE. FR-PROXY-016 logging is not added; mid-body failures already throw an IOException caused by ProxyException(INVALID_RESPONSE). As a side effect of the shared parser, the HEAD/304 relay length already follows FR-PROXY-014 AC-6 (agreed Content-Length or -1).
